what: Agents in flight, and why. A finished agent is REMOVED from this file, not marked done — the page shows what is happening now, and history lives in git.

agents.what: Show the question-writer the founder's whole shortlist, not two thirds of it
agents.why: The AI writes the follow-up questions by reading the funds in front of the founder — but about three in ten of those funds are dropped before it sees them, because their reference codes are longer than a limit nobody revisited. One test founder keeps none of their six. Worse, the questions still name the right funds while the requirements underneath describe a different, shorter list. This is the one lever measurement has actually named.

agents.what: Close the last two checks that have been red without a diagnosis
agents.why: Five of our fifty-one automatic checks are failing. Three now have a named cause and a date they clear. Two do not, and a check that is red for no understood reason is worse than no check at all — it teaches everyone to ignore the colour. One of them is entangled with a cache that, re-cut carelessly, would move the headline accuracy number for reasons unrelated to accuracy.
